title: 第21章 解锁成就求追读第22章 点与线面与体
slug: 从衔尾蛇石碑开始超凡
lines: 晚间，林野走在商业街中，推开一家大型洗浴中心的玻璃门。
“你好，开个桑拿单间。”
没一会，拿着房卡的林野坐电梯上了六楼，房牌号626。
刷卡走进单间，能感觉周围的温度明显上升了几度，皮肤变得有些发黏。
脱去衣服，简单冲洗一遍后，换上桑拿服，拿起衣柜旁的一个矿泉水瓶。
瓶子里装着淡青色的迭罗子油，这是他忙活一下午的成果。
十二斤迭罗子，总共出了差不多两斤油，产量不高，但完全够用了。
走到角落，拉开桑拿屋的帘布，一股热浪涌出来，浑身毛孔都被冲开了。
进到里间，空间不大，只有十平米左右，中央是一个木台，放着桑拿石。
坐下后看了一眼旁边悬挂的温湿表，湿度39%，温度70摄氏度。
微微点头，应该算是高温气体了吧？再热就熟了。
坐了几分钟适应了一下，扭开瓶子，把迭罗子油倒入掌心，随即抹向后背。
也亏得这几天练拳提升了身体柔韧性，不然有些地方真摸不着。
没一会，涂抹完毕，清凉感在脊背浮现，慢慢地变热。
林野有些讶异地感受着脊背上的变化，这股热感，在和热线重叠？
舀一勺水浇到桑拿石上，“刺啦”一声，桑拿房里的温度上升一些。
随着时间推移，后背热感开始变得有些灼痛。
林野微微喘息。
拳谱中有记载，练出气感前热线的灼热感越强烈，就意味着蜕变后的气感品质越高。
可他还没听说过，谁的灼热感能热到感觉到痛。
又过去十几分钟，他强忍着后背的灼痛，舀水往桑拿石上泼过去。
一股热浪涌过来，额头汗珠滑落。
他大口喘息，已经快一个小时了，呼吸都变得有些困难，换成一般人估计已经晕过去了。
而且，这股灼痛感，还有着愈演愈烈的趋势。
又坚持了一会，他忍不住嘶哈吸气，看向计时器，已经彻底来到一小时。
‘还是不行吗？’
这个念头刚刚闪过，他便感觉到后背的肌肉陡然一抽，灼痛感渐渐消退，连带着呼吸都稍微顺畅一些。
成功了？
“丰碑！”
没有犹豫，他的视线落在丰碑下半部分。
【后背涂抹迭罗子油，以高温气体热敷（已完成）】
长舒了一口气，他的脸上露出笑容，终于完成了。
没再停留，直接起身出了桑拿室，再待下去真要晕里边了。
坐在单间的木床边，调息了几分钟，用毛巾擦去额间汗水。
看着丰碑，他在心中默念，
‘丰碑，解锁成就！’
content_en:
In the evening, Lin Ye walked in the commercial street and opened the glass door of a large bathing center.
"Hello, open a sauna room."
After a while, Lin Ye, holding the room card, took the elevator to the sixth floor, room number 626.
When you swipe your card and walk into the single room, you can feel that the surrounding temperature has obviously risen a few degrees, and your skin has become a little sticky.
Take off your clothes, rinse briefly, put on sauna clothes, and pick up a mineral water bottle next to the closet.
The bottle contained light blue Derro seed oil, which was the result of his busy afternoon.
Twelve kilograms of dailuozi yielded a total of almost two kilograms of oil. The yield was not high, but it was completely enough.
I walked to the corner and opened the curtain of the sauna room. A wave of heat rushed out, and the pores all over my body were washed open.
Entering the inner room, the space is not large, only about ten square meters. In the center is a wooden platform with sauna stones.
After sitting down, I glanced at the thermometer and hygrometer hanging next to me. The humidity was 39% and the temperature was 70 degrees Celsius.
Nodding slightly, it should be considered high-temperature gas, right? Reheat and it will be done.
After sitting for a few minutes to get used to it, I opened the bottle, poured the Derro Seed Oil into my palms, and then wiped it on my back.
Fortunately, practicing boxing in the past few days has improved my body's flexibility, otherwise there are some places that I really can't touch.
After a while, after applying it, a cooling sensation appeared on my spine, which slowly turned warm.
Lin Ye was a little surprised to feel the changes on his back. Is this heat overlapping with the hot wire?
Pour a spoonful of water onto the sauna stone, and with a "sting" sound, the temperature in the sauna room rises.
As time went on, the heat in my back started to turn into a bit of a burning pain.
Lin Ye gasped slightly.
It is recorded in the boxing manual that the stronger the burning sensation of the hot wire before practicing the Qi sense, the higher the quality of the Qi sense after transformation.
But he had never heard of anyone whose burning sensation was so hot that it hurt.
Ten minutes later, he endured the burning pain in his back and poured water on the sauna stone.
A wave of heat surged over him, and beads of sweat fell from his forehead.
He was panting heavily. It had been almost an hour. It had become a little difficult to breathe. An ordinary person would have fainted.
Moreover, this burning sensation has a tendency to become more and more intense.
After persisting for a while, he couldn't help but take a breath and looked at the timer. It had already reached one hour.
‘Still not working? ’
As soon as this thought crossed his mind, he felt the muscles in his back suddenly twitch, the burning pain gradually subsided, and his breathing became slightly easier.
Success?
"Monument!"
Without hesitation, his gaze fell on the lower half of the monument.
[Apply derrozi oil to the back and apply hot compress with high-temperature gas (completed)]
He breathed a sigh of relief and a smile appeared on his face, finally done.
I didn't stop any longer, I got up and left the sauna room. I was going to faint if I stayed any longer.
Sitting on the edge of the wooden bed in the single room, I adjusted my breathing for a few minutes and wiped the sweat from my forehead with a towel.
Looking at the monument, he thought silently in his heart,
‘Monument, unlock achievements! ’
title_en: Chapter 21: Unlock Achievements, Chapter 22: Points, Lines, Surfaces, and Objects
